name: Lore for a Price
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I am a jeweler of great renown here in Ironforge!  Well, former renown anyway... I have fallen onto hard times due to the chicanery of a competitor!  A bad reputation in this business spells financial disaster.  As a result, I find myself without a copper to my good-though-currently-sullied name.

I want you to get me five silver bars to finish an order I received - the first in what seems like an eternity.

You get me those five silver bars, and I'll answer your questions on the necklace.
narrative.objectives: Bring five silver bars to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You're all right in my book; I don't care what everyone else has been saying... I kid, I kid!  Seriously, thank you my friend.

Now, the necklace you have is one of my finest creations, but it is missing three gems that help bind magic power to it.  I crafted it for a paladin some time ago.  He was on a self-appointed quest to clear out the "evil taint" present at an excavation site in the Badlands called Uldaman.

Well... that paladin died in Uldaman, and that was just the beginning of my woes.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you got the five silver bars I asked for?  I will share my sad tale of woe with you concerning the necklace you now possess... but only after I get those bars!  Please, help a gnome out, won't ya?

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 41 to 44, 18,425 XP in all.

quests.name: The Shattered Necklace
quests.objectiveText: Search for the original creator of the shattered necklace to learn of its potential value.

quests.name: Lore for a Price
quests.objectiveText: Bring five silver bars to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.

quests.name: Back to Uldaman
quests.objectiveText: Search for clues as to the current disposition of Talvash's necklace within Uldaman.

quests.name: Find the Gems
quests.objectiveText: Find the ruby, sapphire, and topaz that are scattered throughout Uldaman.

quests.name: Restoring the Necklace
quests.objectiveText: Obtain a power source from the most powerful construct you can find in Uldaman, and deliver it to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge.
